TACPLUS_TEST.desc: Tacplus global configuration in TACPLUS table.

TACPLUS_INVALID_TIMEOUT_TEST.desc: Tacplus global configuration with invalid timeout value in TACPLUS table.

TACPLUS_NOT_PRESENT_SRC_INTF_TEST.desc: Tacplus global configuration with a non existent port in TACPLUS table.

TACPLUS_SERVER_TEST.desc: Tacplus server configuration in TACPLUS_SERVER table.

TACPLUS_SERVER_INVALID_PRIORITY_TEST.desc: Tacplus server configuration with invalid priority value in TACPLUS_SERVER table.

TACPLUS_SERVER_INVALID_TIMEOUT_TEST.desc: Tacplus server configuration with invalid timeout value in TACPLUS_SERVER table.

TACPLUS_SERVER_INVALID_AUTH_TYPE_TEST.desc: Tacplus server configuration with invalid auth type in TACPLUS_SERVER table.

TACPLUS_SERVER_INVALID_VRF_TEST.desc: Tacplus server configuration with invalid VRF in TACPLUS_SERVER table.

TACPLUS_TLS_EPSK_TEST.desc: TACACS TLS EPSK server and IPv4 forwarder configuration.

TACPLUS_FORWARDER_IPV6_TEST.desc: TACACS forwarder accepts IPv6 loopback with default port.

TACPLUS_TLS_MISSING_IDENTITY_TEST.desc: TACACS TLS EPSK configuration requires psk_identity.

TACPLUS_TLS_MISSING_REFERENCE_TEST.desc: TACACS TLS EPSK configuration requires psk_secret_ref.

TACPLUS_TLS_INVALID_REFERENCE_TEST.desc: TACACS TLS EPSK reference rejects path syntax.
TACPLUS_TLS_INVALID_REFERENCE_TEST.eStr: TACACS EPSK reference must be an opaque object ID

TACPLUS_TLS_SNI_WITHOUT_DOMAIN_TEST.desc: TACACS TLS SNI requires a domain name.

TACPLUS_TLS_PSK_ONLY_WITH_GROUPS_TEST.desc: TACACS TLS PSK-only mode rejects DHE groups.
TACPLUS_TLS_PSK_ONLY_WITH_GROUPS_TEST.eStr: TACACS TLS psk-only mode cannot configure DHE groups

TACPLUS_TLS_INVALID_GROUP_TEST.desc: TACACS TLS rejects unsupported PSK-DHE groups.
TACPLUS_TLS_INVALID_GROUP_TEST.eStr: TACACS TLS PSK-DHE groups must be a colon-separated supported group list

TACPLUS_TLS_DUPLICATE_COMPATIBILITY_SERV.desc: TACACS server names cannot exist in compatibility and TLS tables.
TACPLUS_TLS_DUPLICATE_COMPATIBILITY_SERV.eStr: A TACACS server name or address cannot exist in both TACPLUS_SERVER and TACPLUS_SERVER_TLS

TACPLUS_TLS_SELF_TARGET_TEST.desc: TACACS TLS upstream rejects the local forwarder endpoint.
TACPLUS_TLS_SELF_TARGET_TEST.eStr: A TACACS TLS upstream cannot target the local forwarder endpoint

TACPLUS_FORWARDER_NON_LOOPBACK_TEST.desc: TACACS forwarder rejects non-loopback listen addresses.
TACPLUS_FORWARDER_NON_LOOPBACK_TEST.eStr: TACACS forwarder listen address must be loopback

TACPLUS_TLS_UNSUPPORTED_FIELD_TEST.desc: TACACS TLS rejects unsupported version-1 fields.
